A '''court-martial''' was a [[Army/Legends|military]] trial.

==History==
In the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Virk]] was court-martialed for [[Treason/Legends|treason]] after a series of incidents in which he scammed the [[Officer/Legends|officers]] under his command.<ref name="tor">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> A few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Dannis Veriga]] was court-martialed after ordering a withdraw from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] after a attack of the [[Eternal Fleet]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] and [[Jesse/Legends|Jesse]], nearly faced a court-martial during a [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|battle]] on [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]], when they disobeyed the orders of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]].<ref name="PoD">{{TCW|Plan of Dissent}}</ref> Later in the war, in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]], Luszgoti, threatened the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null ARC]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]], [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]] with a court-martial when the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]]—whom Luszgoti viewed as inferior regardless of his superior [[Captain/Legends|captain]] rank—commanded the subordinate [[Officer/Legends|officer]] to apologize for the disrespect he voiced to the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] and his adopted [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Kal Skirata]]. Luszgoti's court-martial threat was silenced when temperamental clone [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] proceeded to headbutt the junior [[Navy/Legends|naval]] officer, breaking his nose.<ref name="O66" />

In the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic]], it was a court-martial offense for a member of the military to provide a civilian with a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] such as an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]].<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>

During the onset of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] was court-martialed by her twin brother, Colonel [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], for disobeying a direct order to destroy a fleeing enemy ship. As a result of her act of insubordination during the [[Blockade of Corellia|Blockade]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Solo was stripped of her rank and suspended from military duty.<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref>
